svg.metadata: {"revision": 1, "concept_id": "edu.tree-trunk-five-zone-section", "source_contract": "planning/tactile-masters/source-contract.json", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "design": "Simplified transverse section of mature woody trunk: central heartwood, then sapwood, exaggerated cambium, inner bark/phloem and outer bark. Five boundary circles denote tissue zones, not annual rings. No pith or natural proportion claim.", "geometry_exception": "Index explicitly samples line/area geometry into graphics dots; compatible continuous geometry is shared by swell and ViewPlus.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Single-height dot placement preserves line extent or area/rim extent; no gray encoding and no generic Braille-cell art.
